newsitem.title: USA: Walden Residential buys 994 units, 83 acres.
newsitem.headline: Walden Residential buys 994 units, 83 acres.

text.p: Walden Residential Properties Inc. said Tuesday it bought 994 apartment units and about 83 acres of adjacent land at a development in Nashville, Tenn., for about $48.8 million.
The apartments at the development, Nashboro Village, cost about $43.8 million, while land parcels, a tennis facility and an information centre cost about $5 million, the company said.
Walden, a real estate investment trust based in Dallas, said it plans about $2 million of renovations to the apartments and tennis facility.
It did not say how much the acquisitions would add to earnings. Walden officials could not be reached for comment.
Walden's stock fell 37.5 cents to $24 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
